title: Precision override request and stratified calibration sweep for regulated-client model
creator: Maya Patel
description: Summary: Acme Financial (redacted as regulated-client) reported reproducible accuracy regressions after we applied default INT8 quantization profile to their tuned Llama-3-70B variant. They requested a temporary precision override (allow FP8 on selected attention/kernel layers) and a bespoke stratified calibration sweep using their representative transaction dataset. Goals are to validate PRQA against their eval set, produce a calibrated profile that meets their accuracy thresholds (<=1% latency regression vs baseline and <0.5% drop in key metrics), and provide a repeatable runbook so support can reproduce results for audit.
acceptance_criteria: A calibrated quantization profile that passes the customer's eval suite with accuracy within customer thresholds (<=0.5% absolute loss on primary metric)
A documented precision override spec that limits FP8 to specific layer groups and is gated behind a customer-specific flag
End-to-end reproducible runbook and artifacts (calibration datasets, seed, tooling config) pushed to internal S3 and linked in ticket
Performance target: median inference latency impact <=1% compared to INT8 baseline for their workload; unit cost delta documented
Sign-off from Support Engineering and Applied ML on result and rollback plan
comments: 2026-02-20 Maya Patel: Ticket opened after support triage call with Acme Fin. Customer provided a 10k-sample representative calibration corpus and failing eval logs. Assigned to Liam.

2026-02-21 Liam O'Connor: Did an initial repro on dev cluster. Confirmed top-10 token-level deltas occur in long-tail numeric tokens and date formats. Suspect dynamic range edge cases in attention output quantization.

2026-02-22 Applied a temporary FP8 override on attention projection matrices only and re-ran their eval. Observed primary metric delta drop from 3.2% to 0.45% — meets accuracy target but increases median latency by 4%. Logged detailed traces in tracing dashboard. -- Liam

2026-02-25 Decision: pursue stratified calibration sweep instead of full FP8 fallback. Plan: run 3 calibration strategies (per-layer dynamic range, per-head scaling, and mixed-precision per-block) and evaluate latency/quality tradeoffs. Prioritize minimal FP8 surface area.
2026-02-27 Maya Patel: Noted compliance requirement — we must include a calibration artifact manifest for audit and preserve original random seeds. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-02 Engineering review: PR #4862 introduces a profile flag 'precision.overrides.acme_fin' and a CI job to validate reproductions. Requested more granular telemetry for token categories; assigned to telemetry team as action item.
2026-03-05 Telemetry update: new tag 'calib_acme_fin' added to token traces; dashboard updated: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ACME/calib-acme-fin?orgId=1
2026-03-07 Ran stratified sweep B (per-head scaling) on dedicated-dev-gpu-22. Results: 0.35% metric delta, latency +0.9%. Candidate profile 'acme_fin_sweepB_v3' uploaded to s3.
2026-03-09 PM review (Ravi Singh): Approved candidate for staging rollout. Requested cost delta estimate for Dedicated customers. Assigned follow-up: economics calc by 2026-03-12.
2026-03-10 Liam O'Connor: Drafted final runbook and pushed calibration artifacts to s3. Waiting on Applied ML sign-off for final validation before enabling profile for customer.
